_about: Polish pull review (Builder 2, 2026-11-21). reject: Tatoeba ids turned down, with the reason; a line turned down is never proposed again in any circle. english: a better linked Tatoeba translation. Read for other senses, formal address, case forms not yet taught (a locative or instrumental hidden in a form that looks like a taught one), idioms and odd lines. tak keeps both its Wiktionary senses in its hint (yes; so, like this), so tak-as-so lines stay. Part 2 (2026-11-21): also the dative hidden in jej (powiedz jej, wierzysz jej) and czym as an instrumental, drogi as the genitive of droga (road), zobaczę outside niech zobaczę, stać as afford, chodzi o, liczę się. Part 3 (2026-11-21): also co as every (co roku, co noc), wolno as allowed, myśl as the command, jak tam and co za, the dative jej, and nad with the accusative.
